# Kriyvo AI

> Kriyvo AI is an independent studio in Delhi NCR, India. One web developer and AI automation engineer designs, builds and hands over custom websites, WordPress and PHP sites, AI chatbots, WhatsApp bots, voice agents and n8n / Python workflow automation. Projects start from ₹15K. 115+ projects delivered.

## Services
- [Custom website development](https://kriyvoai.online/services/freelance-website-developer-noida): React, Next.js or PHP websites and web apps
- [WordPress & PHP development](https://kriyvoai.online/services/wordpress-php-development): editable WordPress sites, custom themes, plugins and fixes
- [AI chatbot for your website](https://kriyvoai.online/services/ai-chatbot-for-website): grounded answers, lead capture and human handoff
- [LLM and AI agent development](https://kriyvoai.online/services/llm-ai-agent-development): bounded agents with retrieval and evaluation
- [n8n workflow automation](https://kriyvoai.online/services/n8n-workflow-automation): integrations, triggers, logging and failure handling
- [AI automation engineering](https://kriyvoai.online/services/ai-automation): lead processing, feedback routing and reporting
